High protein breakfast: how to make egg white oats that don’t taste like scrambled eggs.
Three things go wrong:

1. NOT ENOUGH WATER 
don’t cook the oats down completely. You want them still sitting in a little starchy liquid before the egg whites go in, so the whites distribute evenly and thicken gradually instead of catching in the oats and scrambling.

2. HEAT TOO HIGH 
pour egg whites into boiling oats and you have made scrambled eggs. Turn the heat right down first. Pour them in while whisking, until it’s frothy and combined. Then back up to medium and cook until thick.

3. COOKING TOO LONG 
once they’re thick and creamy, off the heat.

Sweet potato egg tarts 🍠
With no flour, healthy, creamy and naturally sweet ✨

Ingredients (makes ~4 tarts)

Crust
100g mashed sweet potato
5 tbsp almond flour
1 pinch of salt

Filling
2 egg yolks
2 tbsp Greek yogurt
1 tbsp allulose (or sweetener of choice)
50ml milk

Method

1. Mix mashed sweet potato, almond flour, and salt until combined.
2. Press into silicone molds and air fry at 170°C for 7 minutes.
3. Whisk together egg yolks, Greek yogurt, allulose, and milk until smooth.
4. Pour filling into the baked crusts.
5. Air fry again at 170°C for 5 minutes, until the filling is just set.
6. Let cool slightly before removing from molds. Enjoy warm or chilled.
